boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase activities at Hendrix College and nearby Faulkner County Library, with eligibility and scheduling notes from official sources.

cards.title: Browse the Windgate galleries
cards.subtitle: Contemporary exhibitions on the Hendrix campus
cards.notes: Bring a friend and compare reactions as you move through the current exhibitions; check the museum before visiting for gallery availability.
cards.short_summary: A free, conversation-friendly art outing inside Hendrix’s teaching museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Hendrix states that the Windgate Museum presents art exhibitions and is free and open to all.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to students, faculty, staff, and other campus visitors; confirm current exhibition access with the museum.

cards.title: Join a Windgate learning program
cards.subtitle: Free museum programming for campus and community
cards.notes: Choose a program tied to the current art, then stay afterward to trade observations with classmates or other attendees.
cards.short_summary: Museum-led learning turns an exhibition visit into a shared discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: The Windgate Museum’s official page says it offers educational programs and that the museum is free and open to all.
cards.access_notes: Program dates vary; consult the museum for the current schedule. The museum describes itself as free and open to all.

cards.title: Catch an art lecture at Windgate
cards.subtitle: Free talks connected to museum programming
cards.notes: Pick a lecture that crosses into a class interest, arrive with one question, and compare takeaways with friends afterward.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost way to add expert context to the art on display.
cards.evidence_claim: Hendrix identifies lectures among Windgate Museum offerings and says the campus museum is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Lecture schedules vary. Verify the selected program on the museum or Hendrix public-events calendar before going.

cards.title: Make something at a Windgate workshop
cards.subtitle: Hands-on programming at Hendrix’s art museum
cards.notes: Watch for a workshop that fits your schedule, invite a friend, and confirm whether supplies or advance registration are involved.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on, no-admission museum activity with room for conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Hendrix lists workshops among the offerings at the Windgate Museum and states that the museum is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Check the individual workshop listing for capacity or registration requirements; the museum itself is free and public.

cards.title: Watch a film at Windgate
cards.subtitle: Museum screenings without an admission charge
cards.notes: Check the upcoming program, meet your group before the screening, and leave time afterward to unpack the film together.
cards.short_summary: A free campus movie outing framed by the museum’s cultural programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Hendrix lists film screenings among Windgate Museum offerings and says the museum is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Screenings occur on selected dates; confirm the film, venue, capacity, and any reservation instructions before attending.

cards.title: Meet up at a Windgate social program
cards.subtitle: Free art-centered gatherings open beyond campus
cards.notes: Choose a listed social program, bring someone from outside your usual circle, and use the artwork as an easy conversation starter.
cards.short_summary: An art-centered gathering designed for both Hendrix and visiting participants.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official page says Windgate presents social activities and is free and open to all.
cards.access_notes: Social programs are scheduled rather than continuous; verify the selected gathering with Windgate Museum before visiting.

cards.title: Hear Matthew Dicks on storytelling
cards.subtitle: October 5, 2026, in Worsham Hall
cards.notes: Meet your group at Worsham Hall before the 7 p.m. talk and bring a storytelling question to discuss after the lecture.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled fall lecture for sharing ideas about writing, teaching, and storytelling.
cards.evidence_claim: Hendrix says Matthew Dicks will speak in Worsham Hall at 7 p.m. on October 5, 2026, and that the event is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Bestselling Author Matthew Dicks visiting Hendrix College to deliver lecture and lead Gill Preaching Workshop
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Monday, October 5, 2026, at 7 p.m. in Worsham Hall; free and open to the public.

cards.title: See a Hendrix Players show
cards.subtitle: Student theatre with free public admission
cards.notes: Check the department page for the next production, reserve when requested, and meet outside Cabe Theatre before curtain time.
cards.short_summary: Student-produced theatre provides a free group night out when performances are scheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hendrix Theatre Arts and Dance page states that all listed Hendrix Players shows are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Hendrix College | Theatre Arts and Dance
cards.access_notes: Productions run on selected dates, and reservations may be requested despite free admission; consult the department page.

cards.title: Team up at a career workshop
cards.subtitle: Free programming for Hendrix students and alumni
cards.notes: Invite a classmate to a workshop or information session, then compare notes and turn the advice into one concrete next step.
cards.short_summary: A practical, social way to explore careers without paying an event fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Hendrix Career Services says its workshops, information sessions, recruiter visits, and other events are free and open to all students and alumni.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Hendrix students and alumni; use the Career Services calendar to confirm the next event and its location.

cards.title: Practice English in a library group
cards.subtitle: Free ESL class at the Conway library
cards.notes: Join the September 14 session at 6:30 p.m. if the class fits your learning goals, and arrive ready to practice with others.
cards.short_summary: A welcoming, no-cost group class for non-native English speakers.
cards.evidence_claim: Faulkner County Library lists a free ESL class for non-native speakers at its Conway branch on September 14, 2026, from 6:30 to 7:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for September 14, 2026, from 6:30 to 7:30 p.m. at 1900 Tyler Street; the library explicitly describes the class as free.
